name: io.github.yanglinfeng/mcp-memory-bridge
title: Memory Bridge
description: Local-first MCP memory on SQLite: evidence citations, audit trail, namespace isolation.

runtimeArguments.name: -i
runtimeArguments.description: Keep stdin open. Required by the stdio transport.

runtimeArguments.name: --rm
runtimeArguments.description: Remove the container when the session ends.

runtimeArguments.name: -v
runtimeArguments.description: Persist the SQLite database and derived indexes. Without this volume every memory is lost when the container exits.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_BRIDGE_USER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Trusted local principal the stdio session acts as. The image defaults it to 'default'; the server refuses to start when both this and MEMORY_BRIDGE_MCP_TOKEN are absent.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_BRIDGE_MCP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Account credential used to resolve the startup principal. Alternative to MEMORY_BRIDGE_USER_ID.

environmentVariables.name: MEMORY_BRIDGE_OLLAMA_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the Ollama runtime used for generation and embeddings. Inside a container this is usually http://host.docker.internal:11434.
